source_selection: Traverse entire archive; retain 32000 games by seeded hash priority, up to two positions per opening/middlegame/endgame phase per game; sort retained positions by hash
partition: Seeded game hash 80/10/10; remove duplicate board states crossing partitions; exclude stored EPD and all 500 match-opening positions
search: c22535b restored RootSplit; no search algorithm changes; exactly three Eloi threads

training.initialization: production quantized parameters converted to float32
training.optimizer: existing train_nnue.py evaluation and puzzle updates, unchanged
training.A: two epochs of fresh accepted training evaluations; no puzzle stage
training.B: A followed by three epochs on existing canonical TRAIN puzzle groups, limited deterministically to 12000; exclude fresh held-out game IDs and all fresh held-out child board states
training.C: B followed by one fresh-evaluation epoch to test score recalibration
training.conservative_variants: 25% and 50% parameter interpolation from production toward the lowest-validation-MAE member of A/B/C; quantized and engine-tested separately

development.purpose: candidate selection only; no strength claim

selection: highest completed development score among eligible candidates, then lower validation MAE, then candidate ID; require at least 52% development score to spend confirmation budget
performance_gate: existing depth 1/5/10 medians; at most 15% unexplained slowdown at depth 5/10, before final
reproducibility_gate: two isolated builds of selected candidate must match before final
